summary: A fast eight-wheeled armoured carrier with a remote-controlled cannon. It moves quickly, shreds infantry and light vehicles, and carries a squad safely to the front.

sections.title: Autocannon
sections.how: Select the Stryker and left-click an enemy, or let it fire at anything in range.
sections.body: The cannon fires short, quick bursts from a remote turret. It is deadly against infantry, scouts and light vehicles, and can answer low drones, but it barely scratches a main battle tank.

sections.title: Carry infantry
sections.how: Select infantry, then left-click the Stryker.
sections.body: Up to eight soldiers ride inside. If the Stryker is destroyed its riders get out with light wounds, but while inside they cannot shoot out: the Stryker has no firing ports. Riders cannot be selected until they leave.

sections.title: Unload
sections.how: Select the loaded Stryker and press Unload (n).
sections.body: The riders step out one after another beside the vehicle. Drive close to the objective first, then unload.

sections.title: Repair at the vehicle factory
sections.how: Select the damaged Stryker and press Repair at factory, or left-click your vehicle factory.
sections.body: The Stryker drives to the factory and is repaired for half its price, paid as the health comes back.

tips: Pair it with tanks: the tank fights armour, the Stryker clears the infantry around it.
Unload anti-tank teams behind cover instead of driving the Stryker into a tank.
Use its speed to reach a threatened building before the enemy does.
